head_coach.name: Mohamed Ouahbi
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly flexible system built around a 4-2-3-1 shape that transforms into a fluid 2-3-5 in possession. It emphasizes an aggressive high press, compact defensive lines, quick counter-pressing, and explosive transitions. One fullback steps into the midfield to create an overload while creative players operate between the lines to break down low blocks.

key_players.name: Achraf Hakimi
key_players.performance_stats: PSG and national team captain. Registered 3 goals, 16 assists, and 19 clean sheets across all competitions in the 2025/26 season with PSG, winning Ligue 1, AFCON, and the Champions League. Renowned for world-class pace, high-volume key passes, crossing accuracy, and strong defensive contributions.

key_players.name: Ismael Saibari
key_players.performance_stats: Eredivisie Player of the Season for 2025/26 with PSV before agreeing to a €50m+ transfer to Bayern Munich. Averaged a 7.20 Sofascore rating, 1.96 key passes, 1.78 successful dribbles, and 9.74 ball carries per game. Scored a magnificent opener for Morocco against Brazil at the 2026 World Cup.

key_players.name: Brahim Díaz
key_players.performance_stats: Made 42 appearances for Real Madrid in the 2025/26 season (17 starts) across La Liga and Champions League, registering 9 goal contributions (2 goals, 7 assists). Highly technical playmaker with exceptional acceleration, close control, and vision who won the 2025 AFCON Golden Boot.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup squad after sustaining an MCL sprain (knee injury) during a pre-tournament friendly match against Norway on June 7, 2026.
Withdrawn from the World Cup squad due to a groin injury requiring surgery in March, followed by a pubic bone fracture discovered in April.
Sidelined from the national team setup after sustaining an injury during the Africa Cup of Nations final in January 2026.
Omitted from the final World Cup squad due to an ankle injury sustained in mid-March 2026, as the head coach prioritized perfect match fitness.
